baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prohibition in "do not suppose," the negated inattentiveness, and the exclusive "He only delays them."
baseline_models.mechanism: The two live branches of ح س ب make the supposition behave like a faulty account: visible non-intervention is entered as lack of attention, while the verse recodes the interval as deliberate scheduling.

activation_trace.role: Supposition supplies the rejected inference drawn from what appears to be happening.
Counting and accounting make that inference legible as a temporal miscalculation.
Inattention would leave deeds outside vigilance, precisely the state the verse negates.
Deferral to a later time replaces neglect as the cause of the visible interval.

changed_reading.before: The verse generally reassures that God knows about wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: The verse diagnoses a specific bad inference: delayed response is being miscalculated as absent attention, although the delay itself is intentional.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction "what the wrongdoers do" joins an agent label to ongoing intentional action.
baseline_models.mechanism: Wrongdoing is not merely an identity; it is repeatedly produced through purposeful acts that displace what belongs in its proper setting or withhold a due right. Divine attention attaches to the doing.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful action supplies the operational character of the wrongdoing.
Withholding a right gives the agents' work a concrete social and legal mechanism.
Misplacing something in time or place adds a material ordering failure to the injustice.
Leaving something unrecorded supplies the evidentiary possibility explicitly denied of God.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers are a fixed condemned group.
changed_reading.after: They are identified by an accumulating practice of intentional displacement and withheld rights, none of which is left outside notice or record.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The endpoint is a day in which the eyes تشخص.
baseline_models.mechanism: The day is defined through involuntary ocular posture: sight rises and remains open under anxiety. Judgment first appears as loss of control over where and how one can look.

activation_trace.role: A severe event, rather than an ordinary date, supplies the character of the appointed day.
Raised, opened, unblinking sight supplies the body's fixed response.
An alarming event that makes one start upward supplies the affective cause of fixation.
The physical faculty of sight locates the consequence in the perceiving body.

changed_reading.before: The day will contain a frightening sight.
changed_reading.after: The day seizes the faculty of looking itself: eyes are forced upward and held open, making judgment an embodied loss of visual agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier divine delay is joined to forgiveness and an appointed term; after the focus, the wrongdoers ask for delay to a near term so that they can answer and follow. The same temporal operation reverses from an available response-window into an unavailable last request.

activation_trace.role: The focus's later scheduling is the hinge between the two contextual uses of delay.
Protective covering of fault makes the earlier appointed delay a possible interval of forgiveness.
Delay to a later time supplies the first, divinely offered interval.
A fixed temporal limit prevents that interval from meaning indefinite tolerance.
The wrongdoers' plea repeats delay after the scheduled day has arrived.
Temporal nearness makes the requested extension minimal but still too late.
Answering speech names the response they promise only after the first interval closes.
Following supplies the practical compliance deferred until it can no longer alter the outcome.

structural_cues: 14:10 offers delay to an appointed term; 14:42 names deliberate delay; 14:44 voices a failed request for another delay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the mirrored delay clauses, forgiveness, fixed term, and promised response; I infer that the first delay functions as a bounded opportunity whose refusal produces the second plea. A live alternative is that 14:10 concerns only lifespan, without emphasizing opportunity.

changed_reading.before: God postpones punishment until a terrifying day.
changed_reading.after: The postponement is also a bounded response-window: its recipients mistake available time for neglect and ask for that same time only after it has closed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly separates intentional production, acquired result, coercive power, disclosed consequence, and matching recompense. Delay preserves rather than blurs the attribution between what wrongdoers do and what returns to each self.

activation_trace.role: The focus names purposeful work as the object of uninterrupted attention.
Intentional works become the material whose apparent substance is tested.
Acquisition ties the dissipating works back to what their agents sought and gained.
The denial of coercive power blocks transfer of responsibility to the caller.
Disclosed divine action supplies the consequence-side of the causal ledger.
Matching an act with its return makes the endpoint responsive rather than arbitrary.
What each self acquired supplies the individualized basis of recompense.

structural_cues: Works disperse in 14:18, coercive authority is denied in 14:22, prior outcomes are made clear in 14:45, and recompense matches acquisition in 14:51.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated action, acquisition, power, disclosure, and recompense terms; I infer an evidentiary chain in which delay allows agency to remain attributable. An alternative is a looser moral sequence without a procedural function for delay.

changed_reading.before: God observes the wrongdoers' actions before later punishment.
changed_reading.after: The observed actions remain attached to their agents through a causal ledger: no coercive power excuses them, and each acquisition receives its corresponding return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Failed human enumeration of gifts leads into the day when account stands, the focus's prohibition against faulty supposition, and the final swift account. Apparent slowness belongs to the waiting interval, not to reckoning once due.

activation_trace.role: The accounting branch turns the forbidden supposition into a faulty calculation about time and attention.
Counting supplies the attempted human inventory of divine gifts.
Exhaustive enumeration fails, exposing the limits of the human ledger.
The standing account immediately before the focus supplies its explicit judicial horizon.
Recompense pairs the account with an exact responsive outcome.
Speed, the opposite of slowness, resolves the apparent contradiction between delay and account.
Final accounting closes the lexical ring opened by human counting and the focus's rejected reckoning.

structural_cues: 14:34, 14:41, 14:42, and 14:51 form an ordered count-account sequence around the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated counting roots and their order; I infer that uncounted present generosity plus deferred settlement generates the wrongdoers' accounting error. A live alternative is simple lexical recurrence without a single ledger mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The imperative only forbids thinking that God is unaware.
changed_reading.after: It also corrects temporal bookkeeping: humans cannot inventory present gifts, yet infer from delayed settlement that no account is running, even though the account is swift when it arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the focus, hidden and public material are equally known; afterward prior outcomes become clear, all persons emerge exposed, and covering falls over faces. Delay changes the wrongdoers' exposure, not God's access to information.

activation_trace.role: Negated inattention anchors the contrast between present divine access and future human exposure.
Physical sight anchors the exposure sequence in the focus's perceiving bodies.
Concealment supplies the category that is explicitly unavailable against divine knowledge.
Public manifestation is paired with hidden material as equally accessible.
Prior outcomes becoming manifest supplies a historical mode of disclosure.
Emergence into exposure supplies the public endpoint of the delayed interval.
A covering that overtakes the surface reverses any expectation that concealment protects.
The face as forward surface localizes the final covering on the exposed person.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from hidden/public knowledge in 14:38 to staring eyes, historical clarification, open emergence, and finally covered faces.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the concealment, manifestation, exposure, and covering sequence; I infer an asymmetry in which God already sees while wrongdoers are progressively made visible and unable to manage sight. The alternative is that these are separate epistemic and punitive images.

changed_reading.before: God is not unaware now and will make wrongdoers see later.
changed_reading.after: Nothing becomes newly visible to God; the scheduled change is on the wrongdoers' side, where concealment fails, bodies emerge, and sight can no longer regulate exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah distributes the focus's ocular verb across rushing approach, elevated heads, failed return of the blink, and emptied hearts. The gaze is one component of a coordinated collapse of posture, attention, and inward capacity.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies raised, fixed sight as the bodily anchor expanded by the next ayah.
Rushing forward gives the fixed gaze an involuntary locomotor setting.
Unlowered elevation fixes the head orientation that supports the upward stare.
The blink and glance fail to return, converting staring into sustained loss of visual control.
A heart weakened as though absent gives the outward fixation an inward collapse.
Air and vacancy supply the emptied condition of the inward center.

structural_cues: 14:43 is a syntactic continuation of the day-clause in 14:42 and anatomically expands its eyes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies movement, head elevation, nonreturning glance, and inward vacancy; I infer one coordinated sensorimotor mechanism rather than a list of symptoms. A live alternative is that the images accumulate affectively without a single physiological chain.

changed_reading.before: The eyes stare upward from fear.
changed_reading.after: The entire person is captured: forward motion continues, the head cannot lower, the blink cannot return, and the inward center has no capacity left to redirect the gaze.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's "do not suppose God inattentive" is echoed five ayat later by "do not suppose God failing His promise." The paired prohibitions close both escape routes from delayed fulfillment: neither missing knowledge nor a missed commitment explains the wait.

activation_trace.role: The first supposition wrongly converts delay into absent awareness.
Inattention names the epistemic failure denied in the first prohibition.
The repeated supposition formally pairs the later correction with the focus.
A promise missing its appointed time supplies the second false explanation of delay.
A promise bounded by time or place makes fulfillment compatible with waiting.
Punitive response after rejection supplies the promised action toward which delay moves.

structural_cues: The near-verbatim prohibitions at 14:42 and 14:47 frame the intervening panic, plea, inherited ruins, and plotting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated ح س ب construction and the failure-of-promise branch; I infer a deliberate two-part correction of the observer's model of divine delay. The alternative is emphatic repetition without a knowledge-versus-promise distinction.

changed_reading.before: The focus denies only that God has overlooked wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: Together with 14:47 it denies both ignorance and nonfulfillment: God knows the deeds, retains the commitment, and schedules rather than abandons its execution.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the form-distant branch of غ ف ل for an unmarked road or creature, so it is surprising; it remains anchored in the focus's negated root and is activated by visible signs, clarification, warning, and reminder across the surah. Render only as an exploratory evidentiary metaphor, not as the primary lexical sense of غافلا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The negation of غافلا can activate not only inattentiveness but the image of something left without a distinguishing mark.

activation_trace.role: An unmarked route or creature supplies the exploratory image of deeds or time left without evidentiary marks.
Visible signs supply marks that make the historical interval readable.
Meaning disclosed through speech or sign supplies explicit evidentiary clarification.
Warning that awakens caution makes the delayed interval communicative rather than blank.
Reminder supplies a recurring marker against forgetful reading of the delay.

changed_reading.before: God is not mentally inattentive to the wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, neither their deeds nor the waiting interval are left trackless: signs, examples, warning, and reminder keep marking what apparent delay might make seem blank.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is surprising because it connects the same فؤاد and ه و ي pair across different scenes and senses; it remains anchored through the focus's eyes and the immediate continuation's hearts. Qualify it as a lexical-structural reversal, not as proof that the two scenes are direct opposites in every respect.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's immobilized eyes stand between a prior scene of hearts inclining and a following scene of hearts as air.

activation_trace.role: Inner discernment keeps the focus's physical eyes connected to an inward faculty.
The heart as an inwardly kindled center supplies the subject of directed attraction.
Inclination of desire gives those hearts an object and direction.
A heart weakened as if absent reverses the earlier inwardly active center.
Air and vacancy reverse directed inclination into an objectless interior.

changed_reading.before: Staring eyes simply register external terror.
changed_reading.after: The gaze may mark a reversal in orientation: where living hearts could incline toward an object, the judged body has outward fixation paired with an inward center emptied of direction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This spatializes temporal delay through the departure branch of ش خ ص and the contextual removal of supposedly stable structures, making it branch-distant but still anchored in يؤخرهم and تشخص. Present it as a secondary spatial model; it should not replace the direct reading of fixed eyes and delayed judgment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins postponement with a root that can denote departure from a place, while ظلم can image putting something outside its proper time or place.

activation_trace.role: Temporal deferral supplies a period in which displacement is held back.
Departure from a place supplies the exploratory spatial edge of the focus's ocular verb.
Wrong placement in time or space links injustice to disordered location.
Claimed continuance supplies the wrongdoers' confidence that their condition will not pass.
Removal from place or state reverses the preceding claim of continuance.
A solid elevated mass supplies the strongest apparent object of stable emplacement.
One thing standing in place of another supplies total replacement at the endpoint.
The lower ground itself becomes the object replaced, scaling displacement beyond individual removal.
Forced emergence completes the move from deferred emplacement to exposed relocation.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers remain temporarily where they are and are punished later.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, delay holds back a comprehensive displacement: presumed permanence, mountain-like stability, the ground itself, and finally the wrongdoers' own emplacement are all overturned.

strongest_changes: The delay becomes a bounded response-window whose recipients request a second time only after the first closes.
The count-account sequence recasts apparent impunity as faulty temporal bookkeeping and distinguishes delayed settlement from swift reckoning.
The staring eyes expand into a full-body capture of motion, head posture, blinking, and inward capacity.
The paired prohibitions in 14:42 and 14:47 deny both missing knowledge and failed promise as explanations of delay.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context turned one apparent gap between deed and consequence into several coexisting mechanisms: offered respite, preserved agency, active accounting, asymmetric exposure, bodily seizure, and promise fulfillment. The repeated roots around the focus also supported contained readings of marked time, reversed heart-orientation, and deferred displacement.
remaining_uncertainties: The ledger reading may be a rhetorical network rather than a procedural account of why delay occurs.
The heart-orientation reversal depends on treating the repeated فؤاد and ه و ي pair as deliberate cross-scene activation.
The unmarked-interval and deferred-displacement readings rely on form-distant branches and should remain exploratory.
